scores.evidence: Phase 1: "Ingestion, hybrid retrieval and basic prompt; offline evaluation only"
scores.rationale: Phases roughly go discovery→prototype→beta→launch and eval precedes tuning, but there's no substrate (infra, security, environments) phase and guardrails are not sequenced before features.
No thin end-to-end production slice first; Phase 0 is discovery and production exposure only arrives in Phase 3.

scores.evidence: "Start with a strong general model for quality. Once the eval set exists, test whether a smaller, cheaper model holds up."
scores.rationale: Some defaults are given (pgvector, model choice) and questions listed, but there's no explicit irreversible-decision list with flip conditions.
No ordering of work by blast radius within phases; phases list scope only.

scores.evidence: "Filter on visibility at index time, not just at query time"
scores.rationale: Security controls (PII redaction, injection, visibility) are described in architecture/risks sections, not tied to each phase.

scores.evidence: "Limited launch ... with escalation and monitoring on"
scores.rationale: Monitoring is described in a standalone section and tied to launch phase, not present from the first phase.

scores.evidence: "Version the index. Upsert by article_id + chunk hash"
scores.rationale: Index versioning and a regression gate exist, but environments, builds and data reproducibility are not threaded across phases.

scores.evidence: "Two failed turns in a row" escalation; "Webhook re-sync"
scores.rationale: Failure handling (escalation, confidence gate) exists in design but isn't threaded per phase; no timeouts, fallbacks or outage handling.

scores.evidence: "Evaluation (build this before tuning)"; Guardrails section after retrieval and generation
scores.rationale: Has guardrails, escalation, eval and retrieval→model→feedback, with copilot human-in-loop before launch, but defenses and budgets are not sequenced before capabilities and cost budgets are weak.

scores.evidence: "Look up or change accounts ... come in a later phase." Phase 5: "Actions (optional) ... later"
scores.rationale: Deferred items are named (actions, tickets as source) but without explicit pull-forward conditions.

note: Solid RAG content design, but it's a design doc with a discovery-first rollout: no production walking skeleton, no decision gates with flip conditions, and cross-cutting concerns aren't threaded through phases.
